say:2:1510268001:0.text: I'm deeply grateful that you're willing to consider peace talks. This means more to me than words can express.
say:2:1510268001:0.source_cn: 诸位愿意提供和谈的机会，我对此感激不尽。

say:5:1510268004:1.text: As a mage allied with Halians, let me warn you...
say:5:1510268004:1.source_cn: 替人类做事的魔法师，我提醒你……

say:6:1510268005:0.text: You cannot fathom the power you've dared to disturb. One wrong move, and you're dead.
say:6:1510268005:0.source_cn: 你不知道自己正在面见何等尊贵的存在，任何轻举妄动都会为...

say:7:1510268006:1.text: Noble Chieftain, even before setting foot in Wildborn lands, I sensed a formidable presence shrouding Wrathwood Grove.
say:7:1510268006:1.source_cn: 首领阁下，尚未踏足雅库伯尔的领地时，我便感知到一股强大...

say:8:1510268007:1.text: So, you don't need to worry. I meet you with all my humility and honesty... especially before the powerful presence I sense.
say:8:1510268007:1.source_cn: 因此您不必担忧，我会以自己所有的谦逊和坦诚面对您，以及...

say:10:1510268009:0.text: Before you stands the Herdmaster, the Wild Moon of the sky.
say:10:1510268009:0.source_cn: 立于你面前的，是兽群之主，雅库伯尔之月。
say:10:1510268009:0.male: Before you stands the Herdmaster, the Wild Moon of the sky.
say:10:1510268009:0.female: Before you stands the Herdmaster, the Wild Moon of the sky.

say:11:1510268010:0.text: Show respect, and we'll share the kill's blood together. Spurn us, and the winds will slit your throat while wildfire burns your flesh!
say:11:1510268010:0.source_cn: 若你敬畏，便可与我等同饮猎物鲜血；若你亵渎，便会遭疾风...

say:12:1510268011:0.text: Merlin, mage of the Halians, step forward. Present yourself to the Hunting God.
say:12:1510268011:0.source_cn: 名为梅林的魔法师，上前一步！觐见我等以生命侍奉的神明！
say:12:1510268011:0.male: Merlin, mage of the Halians, step forward. Present yourself to the Hunting God.
say:12:1510268011:0.female: Merlin, mage of the Halians, step forward. Present yourself to the Hunting Goddess.

say:15:1510268013:0.text: The mage who calls herself Merlin looks at you, a flicker of doubt in her eyes—quickly replaced by what seems like genuine reverence. Was it just your imagination?
say:15:1510268013:0.source_cn: 这位自称梅林的魔法师看向你时，眼睛里好像闪过了一丝疑惑...
say:15:1510268013:0.male: The mage who calls herself Merlin looks at you, a flicker of doubt in her eyes—quickly replaced by what seems like genuine reverence. Was it just your imagination?
say:15:1510268013:0.female: The mage who calls herself Merlin looks at you, a flicker of doubt in her eyes—quickly replaced by what seems like genuine reverence. Was it just your imagination?

say:17:1510268014:1.text: Great Hunting God, I bow before you.
say:17:1510268014:1.source_cn: 狩猎神，请接受我谦卑的致意。
say:17:1510268014:1.male: Great Hunting God, I bow before you.
say:17:1510268014:1.female: Great Hunting Goddess, I bow before you.

say:18:1510268015:1.text: There is courage in this one. She stands before divinity and barely flinches. The Herdmaster respects those who are fearless.
say:18:1510268015:1.source_cn: 有骨气，直面神明，也仅有些许惊慌。狩猎神欣赏有胆识的人。
say:18:1510268015:1.male: There is courage in this one. She stands before divinity and barely flinches. The Herdmaster respects those who are fearless.
say:18:1510268015:1.female: There is courage in this one. She stands before divinity and barely flinches. The Herdmaster respects those who are fearless.

say:19:1510268016:1.text: State your business. Why are you here?
say:19:1510268016:1.source_cn: 说吧，神明正在聆听你到来的理由。

say:20:1510268017:1.text: In the presence of a deity, pleasantries are meaningless. I shall state my purpose directly.
say:20:1510268017:1.source_cn: 在狩猎神面前，任何多余的辞藻都会失去意义，我将直言自己...
say:20:1510268017:1.male: In the presence of a deity, pleasantries are meaningless. I shall state my purpose directly.
say:20:1510268017:1.female: In the presence of a deity, pleasantries are meaningless. I shall state my purpose directly.

say:21:1510268018:1.text: Please spare the Halian captives their lives.
say:21:1510268018:1.source_cn: 神啊，请放人类战俘一条生路。
say:21:1510268018:1.male: Please spare the Halian captives their lives.
say:21:1510268018:1.female: Please spare the Halian captives their lives.

choice_prompt:22:1510268018.text: Please spare the Halian captives their lives.
choice_prompt:22:1510268018.source_cn: 神啊，请放人类战俘一条生路。
choice_prompt:22:1510268018.male: Please spare the Halian captives their lives.
choice_prompt:22:1510268018.female: Please spare the Halian captives their lives.

say:23:1510268019:1.text: The battles have been fierce, and I've seen many Wildborn warriors suffer from grave wounds. We would like to offer healing medicines to help.
say:23:1510268019:1.source_cn: 之前战事激烈，我也看到雅库伯尔尚有许多重伤未愈的勇士，...
say:23:1510268019:1.male: The battles have been fierce, and I've seen many Wildborn warriors suffer from grave wounds. We would like to offer healing medicines to help.
say:23:1510268019:1.female: The battles have been fierce, and I've seen many Wildborn warriors suffer from grave wounds. We would like to offer healing medicines to help.

say:24:1510268020:1.text: In addition, the Halians are willing to hand over some of their weapons as a show of good faith, proof that they truly want peace.
say:24:1510268020:1.source_cn: 除此之外，人类方还愿意呈上一部分武器，以此表示寻求和平...
say:24:1510268020:1.male: In addition, the Halians are willing to hand over some of their weapons as a show of good faith, proof that they truly want peace.
say:24:1510268020:1.female: In addition, the Halians are willing to hand over some of their weapons as a show of good faith, proof that they truly want peace.

say:25:1510268021:1.text: Weapons are useful. However, who can guarantee that the Halians won't just give us their scrap metal?
say:25:1510268021:1.source_cn: 武器有用。不过，谁能保证呼临人不会拿来破铜烂铁？

say:26:1510268022:1.text: They may not be the newest weapons, but I believe you won't be disappointed when you see them.
say:26:1510268022:1.source_cn: 尽管无法提供崭新的武器，但我想，您看到后不会失望的。

say:27:1510268027:0.text: If they really want peace, then return Mirehold to us!
say:27:1510268027:0.source_cn: 如果人类真的想要和平，就把水泽营地还给我们！

say:28:1510268028:0.text: That was our land! Our home! And those damn humans didn't just take it. They enslaved our kin who lived there!
say:28:1510268028:0.source_cn: 那是我们重要的领地，人类不但出手占领，还奴役着我们生活...

say:29:1510268029:1.text: Slavery? No, I passed by Mirehold on the way here. I didn't see the evil you speak of.
say:29:1510268029:1.source_cn: 奴役？我来时曾路过水泽营地，并没有见到您所说的恶行。

say:30:1510268030:1.text: You're their envoy! Of course, you'll speak for them!
say:30:1510268030:1.source_cn: 你是人类的使者，当然会为他们说话！

say:31:1510268031:1.text: My words can't compete with what your own eyes will see. Why not go and find out for yourself?
say:31:1510268031:1.source_cn: 我的言语终究比不过您的双眼，事实究竟怎样，不妨去看看。

say:32:1510268032:0.text: Under the guise of transporting prisoners, the Wildborn can send their representatives to Mirehold. What do you think, Herdmaster?
say:32:1510268032:0.source_cn: 借着运送战俘的由头，雅库伯尔派出代表前往水泽营地，神，...
say:32:1510268032:0.male: Under the guise of transporting prisoners, the Wildborn can send their representatives to Mirehold. What do you think, Herdmaster?
say:32:1510268032:0.female: Under the guise of transporting prisoners, the Wildborn can send their representatives to Mirehold. What do you think, Herdmaster?

choice_prompt:33:1510268032.text: Under the guise of transporting prisoners, the Wildborn can send their representatives to Mirehold. What do you think, Herdmaster?
choice_prompt:33:1510268032.source_cn: 借着运送战俘的由头，兽人们派出代表前往水泽营地，神，以您之见，如何？
choice_prompt:33:1510268032.male: Under the guise of transporting prisoners, the Wildborn can send their representatives to Mirehold. What do you think, Herdmaster?
choice_prompt:33:1510268032.female: Under the guise of transporting prisoners, the Wildborn can send their representatives to Mirehold. What do you think, Herdmaster?

say:34:1510268033:0.text: Although the captives are worthless, letting them crawl back home shows our weakness!
say:34:1510268033:0.source_cn: 俘虏毫无用处，但让他们活着回去，是雅库伯尔的怯懦！

say:38:1510268034:0.text: Herdmaster, I have something to report.
say:38:1510268034:0.source_cn: ……狩猎神大人，加拉有事要禀告。<key:dialog1>
say:38:1510268034:0.male: Herdmaster, I have something to report.
say:38:1510268034:0.female: Herdmaster, I have something to report.

narration:39:1510268036:0.text: Gala kneels at your side and turns to speak.
narration:39:1510268036:0.source_cn: 加拉跪在你的身侧，有话要对你说

narration:40:1510268037:0.text: At your signal, she lowers her voice and whispers...
narration:40:1510268037:0.source_cn: 在你的示意下，她压低了声音……

say:42:1510268038:0.text: The captives are refusing to eat. They will die soon.
say:42:1510268038:0.source_cn: 战俘一直不肯吃饭，他们快死了。
say:42:1510268038:0.male: The captives are refusing to eat. They will die soon.
say:42:1510268038:0.female: The captives are refusing to eat. They will die soon.

choice_prompt:43:1510268038.text: The captives are refusing to eat. They will die soon.
choice_prompt:43:1510268038.source_cn: 战俘一直不肯吃饭，他们快死了。
choice_prompt:43:1510268038.male: The captives are refusing to eat. They will die soon.
choice_prompt:43:1510268038.female: The captives are refusing to eat. They will die soon.

say:44:1510268039:0.text: I know their deaths will complicate your plans. Do you wish to see them?
say:44:1510268039:0.source_cn: 他们现在死掉，会困扰您。您要去看看吗？
say:44:1510268039:0.male: I know their deaths will complicate your plans. Do you wish to see them?
say:44:1510268039:0.female: I know their deaths will complicate your plans. Do you wish to see them?

choice_prompt:45:1510268039.text: I know their deaths will complicate your plans. Do you wish to see them?
choice_prompt:45:1510268039.source_cn: 他们现在死掉，会困扰您。您要去看看吗？
choice_prompt:45:1510268039.male: I know their deaths will complicate your plans. Do you wish to see them?
choice_prompt:45:1510268039.female: I know their deaths will complicate your plans. Do you wish to see them?

say:50:1510268041:0.text: Merlin, the Hunting God will need a moment of reflection to think on your proposal.
say:50:1510268041:0.source_cn: 魔法师梅林，关于你的提议，狩猎神大人需要独处片刻，谨慎思考。
say:50:1510268041:0.male: Merlin, the Hunting God will need a moment of reflection to think on your proposal.
say:50:1510268041:0.female: Merlin, the Hunting Goddess will need a moment of reflection to think on your proposal.

say:51:1510268042:0.text: Praise the Hunting God for his consideration.
say:51:1510268042:0.male: Praise the Hunting God for his consideration.
say:51:1510268042:0.female: Praise the Hunting Goddess for her consideration.

say:52:1510268043:0.text: Come with me, Mage. We will go to the Great Treehouse to await further instructions.
say:52:1510268043:0.source_cn: 魔法师，跟我去主树厅等候神谕。

choice:22:0:1.text: What do you offer in return?
choice:22:0:1.male: What do you offer in return?
choice:22:0:1.female: What do you offer in return?

say:54:1510268023:0.text: The war between the Wildborn and the Halians was born of folly, and to prolong it serves no purpose but ruin.
say:54:1510268023:0.source_cn: 呼临与雅库伯尔的战争本就没有意义，不该继续下去了。

say:55:1510268024:1.text: Besides, with the Wildborn now backed by divine power, the Halians would be wise to stand down.
say:55:1510268024:1.source_cn: 何况，面对如今拥有神助的雅库伯尔，呼临人更应该收手。
say:55:1510268024:1.male: Besides, with the Wildborn now backed by divine power, the Halians would be wise to stand down.
say:55:1510268024:1.female: Besides, with the Wildborn now backed by divine power, the Halians would be wise to stand down.

say:56:1510268025:1.text: This peace will only come when the opportunity arises. If the Wildborn are willing to release the prisoners, I can serve as a bridge to formal peace talks.
say:56:1510268025:1.source_cn: 这场和平总需要一个合适的契机，如果雅库伯尔愿意释放俘虏...

say:57:1510268026:1.text: The Halians won't take this kindness for granted. In gratitude for your mercy, they will strive to offer a worthy reward.
say:57:1510268026:1.source_cn: 人类也不会白白得到好处，为了感谢雅库伯尔的仁慈，神啊，...
